lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ ਘਰੁ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bilaaval mahalaa 1 chaupade ghar 1 ||
lines.translation: Raag Bilaaval, First Mehl, Chau-Padhay, First House:

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ ਕਹਾ ਹਉ ਮੀਆ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: too sulataan kahaa hau meeaa teree kavan vadaaee ||
lines.translation: You are the Emperor, and I call You a chief - how does this add to Your greatness?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ ਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo too dehi s kahaa suaamee mai moorakh kahan na jaaee ||1||
lines.translation: As You permit me, I praise You, O Lord and Master; I am ignorant, and I cannot chant Your Praises. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਦੇਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: tere gun gaavaa dehi bujhaaee ||
lines.translation: Please bless me with such understanding, that I may sing Your Glorious Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਉ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaise sach mahi rahau rajaaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: May I dwell in Truth, according to Your Will. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਅਸਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh hoaa sabh kichh tujh te teree sabh asanaaee ||
lines.translation: Whatever has happened, has all come from You. You are All-knowing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: teraa a(n)t na jaanaa mere saahib mai a(n)dhule kiaa chaturaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Your limits cannot be known, O my Lord and Master; I am blind - what wisdom do I have? ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਕਥੀ ਕਥੇ ਕਥਿ ਦੇਖਾ ਮੈ ਅਕਥੁ ਨ ਕਥਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kiaa hau kathee kathe kath dekhaa mai akath na kathanaa jaaee ||
lines.translation: What should I say? While talking, I talk of seeing, but I cannot describe the indescribable.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਆਖਾ ਤਿਲੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee aakhaa til teree vadiaaee ||3||
lines.translation: As it pleases Your Will, I speak; it is just the tiniest bit of Your greatness. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਤੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਉ ਬੇਗਾਨਾ ਭਉਕਾ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ete kookar hau begaanaa bhaukaa is tan taaee ||
lines.translation: Among so many dogs, I am an outcast; I bark for my body's belly.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat heen naanak je hoigaa taa khasamai naau na jaaee ||4||1||
lines.translation: Without devotional worship, O Nanak, even so, still, my Master's Name does not leave me. ||4||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Bilaawal, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ ਤਨੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਲੰਦਰੁ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: man ma(n)dar tan ves kala(n)dar ghat hee teerath naavaa ||
lines.translation: My mind is the temple, and my body is the simple cloth of the humble seeker; deep within my heart, I bathe at the sacred shrine.

lines.gurmukhi: ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: ek sabad merai praan basat hai baahuR janam na aavaa ||1||
lines.translation: The One Word of the Shabad abides within my mind; I shall not come to be born again. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: man bedhiaa daiaal setee meree maaee ||
lines.translation: My mind is pierced through by the Merciful Lord, O my mother!

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਪੀਰ ਪਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: kaun jaanai peer paraaee ||
lines.translation: Who can know the pain of another?

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਮ ਨਾਹੀ ਚਿੰਤ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ham naahee chi(n)t paraaee ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I think of none other than the Lord. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: agam agochar alakh apaaraa chi(n)taa karahu hamaaree ||
lines.translation: O Lord, inaccessible, unfathomable, invisible and infinite: please, take care of me!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jal thal maheeal bharipur leenaa ghat ghat jot tumhaaree ||2||
lines.translation: In the water, on the land and in sky, You are totally pervading. Your Light is in each and every heart. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਖ ਮਤਿ ਸਭ ਬੁਧਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਮੰਦਿਰ ਛਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sikh mat sabh budh tumhaaree ma(n)dir chhaavaa tere ||
lines.translation: All teachings, instructions and understandings are Yours; the mansions and sanctuaries are Yours as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tujh bin avar na jaanaa mere saahibaa gun gaavaa nit tere ||3||
lines.translation: Without You, I know no other, O my Lord and Master; I continually sing Your Glorious Praises. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jee ja(n)t sabh saran tumhaaree sarab chi(n)t tudh paase ||
lines.translation: All beings and creatures seek the Protection of Your Sanctuary; all thought of their care rests with You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਚੰਗਾ ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jo tudh bhaavai soee cha(n)gaa ik naanak kee aradaase ||4||2||
lines.translation: That which pleases Your Will is good; this alone is Nanak's prayer. ||4||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: bilaaval mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Bilaawal, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸਬਦੁ ਆਪੇ ਨੀਸਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape sabad aape neesaan ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Word of the Shabad, and He Himself is the Insignia.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਜਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape surataa aape jaan ||
lines.translation: He Himself is the Listener, and He Himself is the Knower.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਤਾਣੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kar kar vekhai taan ||
lines.translation: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself beholds His almighty power.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: too daataa naam paravaan ||1||
lines.translation: You are the Great Giver; Your Name alone is approved. ||1||
